test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: Sarah invested $5000 at a simple interest rate of 10% per annum. Find the amount she will receive at the end of three years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = $5000

Rate of interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (5000 × 10 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = 1500

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

⇒ A = 5000 + 1500

⇒ A = 6500

**The amount she will receive at the end of three years is $6500.**
